title: thalictrum alpinum var. microphyllum
intro: Thalictrum alpinum var. microphyllum, commonly known as Dwarf Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Meadow Rue include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
